description: This file defines a class CharacterConvert that provides methods for converting characters to their ASCII/Unicode code points and vice versa. It includes functions for handling single characters, arrays of characters, and considers compatibility modes. The class utilizes helper functions and handles errors related to invalid inputs.

classes.name: CharacterConvert
classes.description: A utility class for converting characters to their ASCII/Unicode values and vice versa, supporting array inputs and compatibility modes.

methods.name: character
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding character. Returns an empty string or an error if input is invalid. Supports array inputs for batch processing.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Converts a character or string to its ASCII/Unicode code point. Returns an error for invalid inputs and supports array inputs.

methods.name: unicodeToOrd
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 character to its Unicode code point using iconv and unpacking.
